chunks: 1399 - The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said in his counsel to ‘Alī, peace be upon him:
"O ‘Alī, hold fast to salat al-layl, hold fast to salat al-layl, hold fast to salat al-layl."

key_terms.اللَّيْلِ: the night, indicating the night prayer
key_terms.بِصَلَاةِ: with the prayer; commitment to prayer
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam ‘Alī عليه السلام, the addressee of the counsel

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about the importance of salat al-layl?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet's صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم emphatic counsel to Imam ‘Alī عليه السلام to maintain salat al-layl. The repeated command highlights the spiritual importance, constancy, and special merit of the night prayer in worship and self-discipline.
